idempotency.receiptReplay: only the same still-valid signed access token claims (owner, session, device and authVersion) used to create the deletion may read the matching digest receipt after that session is revoked

immediateEffects: create a durable account tombstone outside financial dataset epochs
set app user status to DELETING and increment authVersion
accepted.unavailableAdapters: leave their stage PENDING with a safe retryable error; never report purge completion

jobQuery.afterRevocation: only the original unexpired signed access token, matching the job owner, session, device and authVersion, may read deletion progress

disasterRecovery.restoreRule: reapply all imported, non-expired tombstones by owner ID before opening service traffic; only mark applied after status, session revocation and job evidence commit
disasterRecovery.externalImport: restore tooling must provide an authenticated, integrity-checked tombstone manifest; absent or invalid manifest blocks traffic
